title: Pakistan Arms N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Arms N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PAKISTAN ARMS (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
PAKISTAN ARMS
(NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 5th November, 2001]
No.Legis.1(1)2001/7243-48,
dated 5-11-2001.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement,---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Arms
(North-West Frontier Province Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Arms N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 11 of W.P. Ord. XX of 1965

PAKISTAN ARMS (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
PAKISTAN ARMS
(NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 5th November, 2001]
No.Legis.1(1)2001/7243-48,
dated 5-11-2001.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 11 of
W.P. Ord. XX of 1965.--In the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ord. No.
XX of 1965),--
(i)
the Existing section 11 shall be re-numbered as subsection (1) of section 11, and in the marginal heading, the words "as
to licences" shall be deleted; and
(ii)
after subsection (1), as so re-numbered, the following new subsection shall be added, namely,--
"(2) Government may also
make rules for the disposal of arms and ammunition confiscated by it under
Ordinance."
